Endorsements and conditions
Endorsement 04 - Garaging. The vehicle must be kept in a locked garage overnight at the address shown. If it is not, the excess for theft is increased by £500.
Endorsement 11 - Telematics. A telematics device must remain fitted and working for the whole period of insurance. We use the data only to price your cover and to handle claims.
Use of vehicle. Social, domestic and pleasure use and commuting to a single place of work are covered, but business use is not.

Cancellation. You may cancel within 14 days of receiving this schedule and receive a full refund if no claim has been made. After that period a charge of £35 applies and the premium is refunded in proportion to the unused days.
Making a claim. Call the claims line as soon as possible after an incident and in any case within 48 hours. Do not admit liability or agree to pay anyone without our consent.
